title: Schedule of Credit Values: Billing Error Correction Credits at a Payment Arrangements Default by Returned Payment Record
content:
**Schedule of credit values — billing error correction credits at a default**
Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)

Billing error correction credits that are applied at a default count according to the returned payment record of the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account over the twelve months ending on the default date. The correction credits are the bill credits with the reason billing error correction posted for the billing period of the latest installment on the agreement.

| Correction credit on the latest bill | Returned payment posted in the twelve months ending on the default date | Correction credits count at |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | full amount |
| yes | at least one | 50 percent (0.5) of their amount |
| no | — | not at all |

**Schedule notes**

1. Every returned payment posted on the service account in the twelve months is a returned payment for this schedule, whatever payment it reversed.

**Hypothetical:** correction credits of $48.00 on the latest bill count as $48.00 on an account with no return in the twelve months and as $24.00 on an account with one return seven months before the default date.
